en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing an ornate neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance castle complex on a wooded hillside. The main building has a tall central tower, decorative gables, arched loggias, ivy-covered walls, and flanking wings with arcaded galleries and statues. In the foreground stands a smaller classical-style building with arched windows and a hipped roof, partly obscured by trees. Printed captions in red appear along the bottom margin.
